ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with an estimated <10% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixel coverage localized to scars and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) scattered non-uniformly across both lobes; concentrated high-intensity clusters of irregular circular forms at the distal tips (barnacle colonies).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a deep vertical bounding-box depth relative to the horizontal width of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations across the entire visible trailing edge; presence of one deep, irregular jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer edges sweeping into sharp, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white/tan) forming dense colonies at the extreme left and right margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible across the dark ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy linear scarring (rake marks) across the entirety of the visible ventral surface and significant barnacle encrustations at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, deep irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
